text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen despite my early decision to make no trades, so I should monitor risk and not assume that simply holding will protect my savings.","Selling Stocks B, E and D at large losses taught me not to make rushed, loss-driven decisions; I should review each holding against clear reasons and my need for stability.","As a retired investor who relies on these savings, I should favor a diversified, lower-volatility approach and avoid frequent trading or taking risks I cannot afford."]}
